nanah_en:
1
00:00:03,850 --> 00:00:10,390
Na-na-na-nah, not today (Stop)

2
00:00:10,440 --> 00:00:14,073
I said "I'm fine" so many
times it started sounding true

3
00:00:14,123 --> 00:00:18,230
I kept my volume on low
like I was told to do

4
00:00:18,280 --> 00:00:21,900
I let them write my story
in the margins of their own

5
00:00:21,950 --> 00:00:25,767
But tonight I'm reading out
loud, and every word's my own

6
00:00:25,817 --> 00:00:31,370
So turn it up, turn it up

7
00:00:31,420 --> 00:00:36,570
The old me's calling, I'm not picking up

8
00:00:36,620 --> 00:00:38,680
Na-na-na-nah, not today

9
00:00:38,730 --> 00:00:43,225
Every "you can't" is fading away

10
00:00:43,275 --> 00:00:45,947
Na-na-na-nah, watch me go

11
00:00:45,997 --> 00:00:52,200
I'm not who I was a year ago

12
00:00:52,250 --> 00:00:56,407
I'm the one they call to fix it,
never one they ask "you good?"

13
00:00:56,457 --> 00:00:59,417
I carried everybody's weather
like I always thought I should

14
00:00:59,467 --> 00:01:02,847
Now I'm learning how to save
a little sunlight for myself

15
00:01:02,897 --> 00:01:07,367
Put the "sorry" in the drawer
and put the "no" up on the shelf

16
00:01:07,417 --> 00:01:11,547
So turn it up, turn it up

17
00:01:11,597 --> 00:01:16,035
The old me's calling, I'm not picking up

18
00:01:16,085 --> 00:01:18,563
Na-na-na-nah, not today

19
00:01:18,613 --> 00:01:24,172
Every "you can't" is fading away

20
00:01:24,222 --> 00:01:27,840
Na-na-na-nah, watch me go

21
00:01:27,890 --> 00:01:34,633
I'm not who I was a year ago

22
00:01:34,683 --> 00:01:36,833
You don't have to be loud to be strong

23
00:01:36,883 --> 00:01:38,553
You've been keeping the beat all along

24
00:01:38,603 --> 00:01:42,640
Every quiet comeback,
every brand-new start

25
00:01:42,690 --> 00:01:48,330
Was a drum you didn't know was your heart

26
00:01:48,380 --> 00:01:49,700
Na-na-na-nah, not today

27
00:01:49,750 --> 00:01:54,205
I don't need permission anyway

28
00:01:54,255 --> 00:02:00,310
Na-na-na-nah, watch me go

29
00:02:00,915 --> 00:02:07,915
I'm not who I was a year ago

30
00:02:13,142 --> 00:02:18,053
Na-na-na-nah... not today (Stop)
nanah_tr:
1
00:00:03,850 --> 00:00:10,390
Na-na-na-nah, bugün olmaz (Dur)

2
00:00:10,440 --> 00:00:14,073
O kadar çok "iyiyim" dedim
ki doğru gibi gelmeye başladı

3
00:00:14,123 --> 00:00:18,230
Sesimi kısık tuttum,
bana öyle söylendiği için

4
00:00:18,280 --> 00:00:21,900
Hikâyemi kendi hikâyelerinin kenar
boşluklarına yazmalarına izin verdim

5
00:00:21,950 --> 00:00:25,767
Ama bu gece yüksek sesle
okuyorum, ve her kelime benim

6
00:00:25,817 --> 00:00:31,370
O yüzden sesi aç, sesi aç

7
00:00:31,420 --> 00:00:36,570
Eski ben arıyor, açmıyorum

8
00:00:36,620 --> 00:00:38,680
Na-na-na-nah, bugün olmaz

9
00:00:38,730 --> 00:00:43,225
Her "yapamazsın" silinip gidiyor

10
00:00:43,275 --> 00:00:45,947
Na-na-na-nah, izle beni

11
00:00:45,997 --> 00:00:52,200
Bir yıl önceki ben değilim artık

12
00:00:52,250 --> 00:00:56,407
Bir şey bozulunca aranan benim,
ama kimse "iyi misin?" diye sormaz

13
00:00:56,457 --> 00:00:59,417
Herkesin havasını taşıdım, hep
öyle yapmam gerekiyormuş gibi

14
00:00:59,467 --> 00:01:02,847
Şimdi biraz güneşi kendime
ayırmayı öğreniyorum

15
00:01:02,897 --> 00:01:07,367
"Özür dilerim"i çekmeceye
kaldır, "hayır"ı rafa koy

16
00:01:07,417 --> 00:01:11,547
O yüzden sesi aç, sesi aç

17

18

Na-na-na-nah, bugün olmaz

19

Her "yapamazsın" silinip gidiyor

20
00:01:24,222 --> 00:01:27,840
Na-na-na-nah, izle beni

21
00:01:27,890 --> 00:01:34,633
Bir yıl önceki ben değilim artık

22
00:01:34,683 --> 00:01:36,833
Güçlü olmak için gürültülü olman gerekmez

23
00:01:36,883 --> 00:01:38,553
Ritmi baştan beri sen tutuyordun

24
00:01:38,603 --> 00:01:42,640
Her sessiz geri dönüş, her yeni başlangıç

25
00:01:42,690 --> 00:01:48,330
Kalbin olduğunu bilmediğin bir davuldu

26
00:01:48,380 --> 00:01:49,700
Na-na-na-nah, bugün olmaz

27
00:01:49,750 --> 00:01:54,205
Zaten kimseden izin istemem gerekmiyor

28
00:01:54,255 --> 00:02:00,310
Na-na-na-nah, izle beni

29
00:02:00,915 --> 00:02:07,915
Bir yıl önceki ben değilim artık

30
00:02:13,142 --> 00:02:18,053
Na-na-na-nah... bugün olmaz (Dur)
upbutme_en:
1
00:00:03,890 --> 00:00:10,890
Everything's going up but me...

2
00:00:20,510 --> 00:00:23,127
Workin' double shifts just
to stay in the same place

3
00:00:23,177 --> 00:00:25,727
Runnin' on a treadmill
with a smile on my face

4
00:00:25,777 --> 00:00:28,603
Payday hits like a wave,
then it's gone with the tide

5
00:00:28,653 --> 00:00:30,967
Every bill gets a seat
while I'm standin' outside

6
00:00:31,017 --> 00:00:33,557
Fill the cart with the
basics, then I put half back

7
00:00:33,607 --> 00:00:36,193
Learned to say "I'm not
hungry" like a magic act

8
00:00:36,243 --> 00:00:39,100
Tell my people "I'm good"
with a voice that don't shake

9
00:00:39,150 --> 00:00:43,020
But I check my balance like
a heart that might break

10
00:00:43,070 --> 00:00:45,670
Everything's going up but me

11
00:00:45,720 --> 00:00:50,340
Rent up, prices up, still I'm on my feet

12
00:00:50,390 --> 00:00:56,990
Act like it's easy, but it's never free

13
00:00:57,040 --> 00:01:01,063
Everything's going up but me

14
00:01:03,100 --> 00:01:05,723
I'm the one they call when
they're short on the rent

15
00:01:05,773 --> 00:01:08,273
Never told 'em I was
short on the money I lent

16
00:01:08,323 --> 00:01:11,080
Got a head full of plans
and a pocket full of lint

17
00:01:11,130 --> 00:01:13,670
And a "someday" I been savin'
like it's somethin' I can spend

18
00:01:13,720 --> 00:01:16,270
They said "tighten your
belt," I ran out of new holes

19
00:01:16,320 --> 00:01:18,960
They said "grind and you'll shine,"
I'm still grindin' these stones

20
00:01:19,010 --> 00:01:21,767
But I ain't built to break,
I was built to rebuild

21
00:01:21,817 --> 00:01:25,690
Every "no" in my pocket
is a seed in the field

22
00:01:25,740 --> 00:01:28,307
Everything's going up but me

23
00:01:28,390 --> 00:01:33,010
Rent up, prices up, still I'm on my feet

24
00:01:33,060 --> 00:01:39,660
Act like it's easy, but it's never free

25
00:01:39,710 --> 00:01:44,887
Everything's going up but me

26
00:01:45,070 --> 00:01:51,457
If you're tired and nobody knows

27
00:01:51,560 --> 00:01:55,147
'Cause you're carrying more than it shows

28
00:01:55,197 --> 00:02:00,517
The sun still rises and
it don't charge a fee

29
00:02:00,567 --> 00:02:06,312
One day it's going up for you and me

30
00:02:08,420 --> 00:02:10,327
Everything's going up but me

31
00:02:11,070 --> 00:02:15,690
Rent up, prices up, still I'm on my feet

32
00:02:15,740 --> 00:02:22,013
Act like it's easy, but it's never free

33
00:02:22,390 --> 00:02:27,990
One day it's going up for me

34
00:02:28,040 --> 00:02:29,823
Everything's going up...

35
00:02:33,870 --> 00:02:35,070
And so am I
upbutme_tr:
1
00:00:03,890 --> 00:00:10,890
Her şey yükseliyor, ben hariç...

2
00:00:20,510 --> 00:00:23,127
Aynı yerde kalabilmek için
çift vardiya çalışıyorum

3
00:00:23,177 --> 00:00:25,727
Yüzümde bir gülümsemeyle
koşu bandında koşuyorum

4
00:00:25,777 --> 00:00:28,603
Maaş günü dalga gibi vuruyor,
sonra gelgitle gidiyor

5
00:00:28,653 --> 00:00:30,967
Her faturaya bir koltuk var,
ben dışarıda ayakta duruyorum

6
00:00:31,017 --> 00:00:33,557
Sepeti temel ihtiyaçlarla dolduruyorum,
sonra yarısını geri koyuyorum

7
00:00:33,607 --> 00:00:36,193
"Aç değilim" demeyi bir
sihirbaz numarası gibi öğrendim

8
00:00:36,243 --> 00:00:39,100
Yakınlarıma titremeyen
bir sesle "iyiyim" diyorum

9
00:00:39,150 --> 00:00:43,020
Ama bakiyeme kırılabilecek
bir kalbe bakar gibi bakıyorum

10
00:00:43,070 --> 00:00:45,670
Her şey yükseliyor, ben hariç

11
00:00:45,720 --> 00:00:50,340
Kira artıyor, fiyatlar
artıyor, ama ben hâlâ ayaktayım

12
00:00:50,390 --> 00:00:56,990
Kolaymış gibi davranıyorum,
ama hiçbir şey bedava değil

13
00:00:57,040 --> 00:01:01,063
Her şey yükseliyor, ben hariç

14
00:01:03,100 --> 00:01:05,723
Kirayı denkleştiremeyince aranan benim

15
00:01:05,773 --> 00:01:08,273
Borç verdiğim parayı benim de
denkleştiremediğimi hiç söylemedim

16
00:01:08,323 --> 00:01:11,080
Kafam planlarla, cebim tiftikle dolu

17
00:01:11,130 --> 00:01:13,670
Ve harcayabilecekmiş gibi
biriktirdiğim bir "bir gün"

18
00:01:13,720 --> 00:01:16,270
"Kemeri sıkın" dediler,
kemerde yeni delik kalmadı

19
00:01:16,320 --> 00:01:18,960
"Çalış, parlarsın" dediler,
hâlâ bu taşları yontuyorum

20
00:01:19,010 --> 00:01:21,767
Ama ben kırılmak için yapılmadım,
yeniden kurmak için yapıldım

21
00:01:21,817 --> 00:01:25,690
Cebimdeki her "hayır",
tarlaya düşen bir tohum

22
00:01:25,740 --> 00:01:28,307
Her şey yükseliyor, ben hariç

23
00:01:28,390 --> 00:01:33,010
Kira artıyor, fiyatlar
artıyor, ama ben hâlâ ayaktayım

24
00:01:33,060 --> 00:01:39,660
Kolaymış gibi davranıyorum,
ama hiçbir şey bedava değil

25
00:01:39,710 --> 00:01:44,887
Her şey yükseliyor, ben hariç

26
00:01:45,070 --> 00:01:51,457
Eğer yorgunsan ve kimse bilmiyorsa

27
00:01:51,560 --> 00:01:55,147
Çünkü göründüğünden fazlasını taşıyorsan

28
00:01:55,197 --> 00:02:00,517
Güneş yine doğuyor ve
bunun için ücret almıyor

29
00:02:00,567 --> 00:02:06,312
Bir gün senin ve benim için de yükselecek

30
00:02:08,420 --> 00:02:10,327
Her şey yükseliyor, ben hariç

31
00:02:11,070 --> 00:02:15,690
Kira artıyor, fiyatlar
artıyor, ama ben hâlâ ayaktayım

32
00:02:15,740 --> 00:02:22,013
Kolaymış gibi davranıyorum,
ama hiçbir şey bedava değil

33
00:02:22,390 --> 00:02:27,990
Bir gün benim için de yükselecek

34
00:02:28,040 --> 00:02:29,823
Her şey yükseliyor...

35
00:02:33,870 --> 00:02:35,070
Ve ben de
